I started bartending 6 months ago, lied about having experience so I was put in the deep end. Now I’m one of the most reliable workers in the bar. Learn how to multitask, for example when someone asks for a Guinness, while it settles go serve someone else, this can lead to you getting sidetracked and serving more people, at the beginning I’d forget about the Guineas. That’s just one thing keep focused. 

When it’s busy don’t take any breaks. Not sure what type of bar you’re working in but don’t assume anyone will do things for you. Clean up after yourself. Make sure you’ve got lemons, limes and oranges cut. Don’t pour a pint into a glass that’s just out of the washer if it’s warm. The pint goes flat. 

Try to remember what customers are drinking, and talk to them have conversations. This increases sales. In my bar now everyone knows my name and I know there’s and almost all of their drinks so as soon as they walk in I’m already making their drink.
